methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches AI training program for workplace professionals - WDBJ7
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's workplace-focused AI training program represents distributed capacity-building outside major metros, though success depends on whether it creates deep implementation skills or surface-level AI literacy.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free community AI workshops in Hampton Roads signal grassroots efforts to distribute capability beyond NoVA, explicitly targeting technology gap closure through peer-to-peer knowledge transfer rather than platform dependency.

signals.title: Digital Realty Acquires $7.8 bn Northern Virginia Data Center Portfolio from Blackstone to Expand AI Infrastructure - InfotechLead
signals.signal_reading: A $7.8B data center infrastructure acquisition concentrates AI compute capacity in NoVA's existing hub, reinforcing the region's structural advantages while potentially widening the physical and economic distance from rural Virginia.

signals.title: AI Has Already Arrived in Roanoke’s Classrooms. Here’s What Parents, Students, and Workers Should Know. - The Roanoke Rambler
signals.signal_reading: AI's arrival in Roanoke classrooms suggests shallow, platform-mediated adoption where tools are consumed rather than deeply understood—distribution without depth unless paired with serious technical workforce development.

signals.title: Virginia budget clears way for $100B Berry Hill data center campus
signals.signal_reading: A $100B Berry Hill data center campus brings infrastructure to historically underserved Southside, but without intentional workforce development programs, it risks creating concentrated physical assets without distributed human capability.
